--- title: "Configuration" description: "Learn the three main config paths (kwargs, YAML, env vars) and see a practical Ollama example." date: today format: html: self-contained: true embed-resources: true code-fold: true code-tools: true --- nano-graphrag offers three ways to configure your instance: direct keyword arguments, YAML files for team sharing, and environment variables for Docker/CI. This notebook demonstrates each approach and shows how to switch to local Ollama models. ## Setup ::: {#setup .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import logging from pathlib import Path logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING) logging.getLogger("nano-graphrag").setLevel(logging.WARNING) WORKING_DIR = Path("./_cache/03_configuration") WORKING_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) from nano_graphrag import GraphRAG from nano_graphrag.base import GraphRAGConfig ``` ::: ## Method 1: Direct Keyword Arguments Simplest approach — best for scripts and notebooks. ::: {#method-kwargs .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} rag = GraphRAG( working_dir=str(WORKING_DIR / "kwargs"), enable_llm_cache=True, chunk_token_size=1200, chunk_overlap_token_size=100, ) print("LLM model: {}".format(rag.llm_model)) print("Embedding dim: {}".format(rag.embedding_dim)) print("Chunk size: {}".format(rag.chunk_token_size)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}

Set via dotenvx: `GRAPH_API_KEY`, `LLM_MODEL`, `EMBEDDING_MODEL`, etc. ::: {#method-env .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} config = GraphRAGConfig.from_env() print("LLM model: {}".format(config.llm_model)) print("Embedding model: {}".format(config.embedding_model)) print("Working dir: {}".format(config.working_dir)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` LLM model: openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it Embedding model: openrouter/qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b Working dir: ./nano_graphrag ``` ::: ::: ## Practical Example: Local Ollama Models No API key needed — runs everything locally. ::: {#ollama-example .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} ollama_config = GraphRAGConfig( working_dir=str(WORKING_DIR / "ollama"), llm_model="ollama/llama3.2", llm_api_base="http://localhost:11434", embedding_model="ollama/nomic-embed-text", embedding_api_base="http://localhost:11434", embedding_dim=768, ) print("\nOllama config:") print(" LLM: {}".format(ollama_config.llm_model)) print(" Embedding: {}".format(ollama_config.embedding_model)) print(" API base: {}".format(ollama_config.llm_api_base)) print(" Dim: {}".format(ollama_config.embedding_dim)) # Uncomment to use: # rag = GraphRAG.from_config(ollama_config) # await rag.ainsert("Your text here") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Ollama config: LLM: ollama/llama3.2 Embedding: ollama/nomic-embed-text API base: http://localhost:11434 Dim: 768 ``` ::: ::: ## Key Config Parameters Reference ::: {#param-reference .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} print(""" Common parameters: working_dir — where all data is stored (default: ./nano_graphrag) llm_model — LLM for extraction + queries (default: from env) llm_cheap_model — cheaper LLM for fast mode embedding_model — embedding model name embedding_dim — embedding vector dimension chunk_token_size — tokens per chunk (default: 1200) chunk_overlap_token_size — overlap between chunks (default: 100) enable_local — enable local query mode (default: True) enable_naive_rag — enable naive RAG mode (default: False) enable_llm_cache — cache LLM responses (default: True) enable_entity_linking — merge duplicate entities (default: False) extraction_batch_size — chunks per LLM call (default: 5) entity_extraction_quality — 'balanced' or 'fast' (default: balanced) """) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Common parameters: working_dir — where all data is stored (default: ./nano_graphrag) llm_model — LLM for extraction + queries (default: from env) llm_cheap_model — cheaper LLM for fast mode embedding_model — embedding model name embedding_dim — embedding vector dimension chunk_token_size — tokens per chunk (default: 1200) chunk_overlap_token_size — overlap between chunks (default: 100) enable_local — enable local query mode (default: True) enable_naive_rag — enable naive RAG mode (default: False) enable_llm_cache — cache LLM responses (default: True) enable_entity_linking — merge duplicate entities (default: False) extraction_batch_size — chunks per LLM call (default: 5) entity_extraction_quality — 'balanced' or 'fast' (default: balanced) ``` ::: :::
